title: The Last Library
intro: Rain taps against the library windows. You wake beside a desk, with no memory of arriving. A bookshelf, a painting and a locked drawer are nearby. The exit has a four-digit keypad. Explore, collect clues and find your way out.
riddle: I have a spine but no bones, and leaves but no branches. What am I?

desk.text: Beneath the ink blotter is a crescent marked 6. A marginal line reads: "The moon follows every other keeper."

bookshelf.text: A loose catalogue card bears a sun stamped 4. On its reverse: "The sun walks immediately before the star."

painting.text: A tiny star in the painted sky carries the numeral 2. The frame is engraved: "The oak is first to greet the visitor."

drawer.text: Inside rests an oak seal marked 8 beside a torn instruction: "Each keeper carries a digit. Follow their procession, not the order of your discoveries."

hint_policy: Give indirect reasoning nudges only. Never recite the combined symbol order, reconstruct the code, or introduce digits in hints. Show each object's own clue only when that object is examined.
